method: Parent summaries of actual fresh image-only reviews and later targeted follow-ups. Image hashes are parent bindings; no independently printed formal rubric/commit bindings. No whole-artwork pass.

reviews.observations: Initial slab torso/plank arm and unclear wrist. Rounded body/curved sleeve improve gesture and wrist, but elbow remains tubular, fingers overlap ambiguously and lower-left triangle unclear. Full tiny markers/leader lines crowd; magnification separates labels but arrows have low contrast.

Rounded silhouette/gesture improve. Remaining oversized ambiguous hand, tube elbow, body edge dividing shoulder, flat neckline, unexplained lower-left wedge, front-facing attention, uneven detail and empty space. Full marker cluster weak; closeup clear except low-contrast arrows and unexplained rotated-local names.

Lower-left shape now reads as hanging sleeve; previous triangle ambiguity resolved. Tube elbow, abrupt wrist and ambiguous grip remain. White halos resolve closeup contrast; full-frame tiny marker/leader cluster remains.

Hanging sleeve now understood at both sizes. Other anatomical/style/attention/assembled shoulder limits remain. All closeup arrowheads visible with halo; full tiny cluster and local-axis explanation still require decoding. Targeted improvements only, not whole-artwork acceptance.
